title: aidentyack.com buttons draw one stitch, not two

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-23 17:30Z: "The Order Custom button has double stitch. Double check all site styrles."

detail: Every Aiden Tyack button draws its stitch as a ::after dash box, and the skin turns the old dashed outline off. Three later rules with higher specificity (the band hero's secondary button, a secondary button in a row of actions, the band FAQ button) brought the outline back, so Order Custom (home, The Maker) and Start a Repair (Care) drew two stitches. They now set outline:0. A computed-style audit of all six live pages at 390 and 1440 (any element with two stitches, or a stitch sitting just inside another) found these three and nothing else, and finds none after the fix.
